_comment: FIX118 — how a turn ended, one closed set for chat-edge (Go), the desktop host (TS) and the web page (TS). Each tree has a test that reads this file; change it here first. `transport_codes` says which catalogue error code a client mints when the failure has no gateway code of its own (backend/app/core/error_catalog.py is the catalogue; GENERATION_INTERRUPTED is chat-edge's own resume code, known to the web dictionary).

cause_meaning.completed: the run produced its answer and said so (message_complete / [DONE])
cause_meaning.error: a terminal error frame named the failure; error_code says which
cause_meaning.timeout: nobody spoke for too long: an idle watchdog or a deadline ended the run
cause_meaning.disconnected: the connection to the provider broke before it said it was done (reset, unexpected EOF, transport throw)
cause_meaning.eof_without_terminal: the provider closed the stream cleanly without [DONE], an error frame or a finish reason
cause_meaning.interrupted: the process that owned the run died; found later by a resume or a ledger replay
